title: Repeat Until Done: while Loops

ai_pair_moment.flaw: Asha asked the AI to add a limit of 3 tries to her loop and to say what the answers 0, 0, 0 print. The AI predicted 'Too many tries. Using 1 tea.' after 3 questions, but its code never changes tries inside the loop, so tries < 3 is always True and the program asks a fourth time (with 5 typed, it prints Teas: 5). Adding tries += 1 inside the loop fixes it.

changes: continue and the else clause of a loop are left out to keep one new idea per step; the curriculum lists while loops, conditions, counters and break.
Augmented assignment (+= and -=) is introduced in Step 3 because running totals and counters use it on every pass.
The infinite loop in Mistake 3 and the AI's countdown in practice task 8 are illustrative fragments, so the verification tool never runs a program that does not end.

The AI section adds video-only verified files: ai_teas_mine.py (Write stage), ai_tries_test_ok.py (Test stage: one wrong answer, then 5) and ai_tries_improve.py (Improve stage: tries <= 3 asks a fourth time).
outstanding_issues: The error report in Mistake 1 shows the short file name; on a learner's computer the full path to the file appears instead.
The narration uses a synthetic voice (Kokoro bm_lewis). The owner should watch the video once and flag any word the voice mispronounces; fixes go in the PRONOUNCE list in tools/voice.py.
